text:
Maya: Need a compact battlecard + webinar hook for next week's launch. Focus: 2 headline tests, 3 conservative benchmark callouts, and a 1-pager SDR crib. Can we lock copy today?
Sam: Yes. Quick plan: headlines, 1-slide benchmark hero, 3 short competitor soundbites, and HubSpot routing rules.
Jo: Bench callouts (legal-friendly): p95 latency for chat (256 tokens), per-token cost under mixed workloads, and failover time when a model variant is unhealthy. Use qualifiers like 'based on internal tests' or ranges.
Nora: Sales asks for 2-line rebutts: A) "We already use cloud provider X" B) "Ops is too heavy". Drafts: A) "We work with your cloud — add a serving layer that reduces runtime spend." B) "Managed defaults + fallbacks reduce ops burden; no need to reimplement runtime plumbing."
Priya: Headline experiments: A) "Same API. Lower cost. Safer rollouts." B) "Serving-first inference for production teams." Also need 6-word ad variants.
Design-bot: Figma draft for hero slide + social tiles: https://figma.com/file/launch/webinar-hero (version 2).
SalesOps: Routing snippet (human-readable) — we'll convert to HubSpot rules:```
if utm_campaign == "webinar_launch" and lead_score >= 80:
  route -> AE_queue
elif utm_campaign == "webinar_launch":
  route -> SDR_queue
if region == "EMEA" and lead_score >= 80:
  route -> EMEA_AE
```
Sam: Good. Legal: Can we say "lower cost" and "predictable" with a footnote?
Legal: Yes. Approve phrasing if we include: "Based on internal benchmarks across representative production mixes; results vary."
Maya: Great. Deliverables: Sam to drop the 3 competitor soundbites, Jo to draft benchmark copy, SalesOps to finalize numeric thresholds, Design-bot to produce assets after copy lock. Diffs to be in thread by EOD. :rocket:
